detail: finding, page 49: The author notes that, through the 2022-2025 programme, the authorities have prioritised removing problems in migration, asylum and integration of foreigners.
finding, page 49: The author finds many points of the 2022-2025 migration programme concern harmonising the legal framework with EU law and international treaties.
intervention, page 49: In March 2022 the emergency commission allowed Ukrainians to be employed on fixed-term contracts, with employers notifying the employment agency within five days.
intervention, page 82: The One-Stop Shop for documenting foreigners was created under Government Decision No. 1187/2010.
finding, page 83: The author observes that the One-Stop Shop is organised as a complex database serving foreigners and the state.
finding, page 84: The author finds the functions of the One-Stop Shop for documenting foreigners consistent with Moldova's international commitments.
finding, page 84: The author finds that involving the employer or requesting beneficiary in the documentation procedure facilitates employment of foreign workers.
finding, page 86: According to the Bureau for Migration and Asylum materials, both the employer and the future foreign employee must submit an application.
finding, page 86: No law provides for the foreign employee's own application, although the Bureau for Migration and Asylum requires it.
recommendation, page 86: The author recommends that the legislator provide in law for the foreign employee's own application.
finding, page 87: The author sees the domestic-candidate test before granting the right to work as protecting nationals from unemployment, which is already high.
recommendation, page 89: The author recommends that both parties sign the working-conditions checklist and the draft employment contract offered to a foreign worker.
finding, page 104: The author finds residence for work is regulated in many respects, with conditions and facilitations depending on the worker's qualification.
finding, page 108: The author finds the Labour Code definition of the employment contract silent on non-citizen parties, and so permissive rather than restrictive.
finding, page 117: The author finds the Public Services Portal accessible and simple for foreigners checking employers, with an English option and free online service.
finding, page 149: The author finds Annex 1 of the labour migration law pays particular attention to pay, safety, accommodation and travel clauses for foreign workers.
finding, page 153: The author finds that obtaining residence for work is the main legal task for both foreign worker and employer.
finding, page 153: The author finds residence for work is regulated in many respects, with conditions and facilitations depending on high qualification.
finding, page 155: The author finds the Labour Code lacks rules on some documents needed in a foreign employee's personal file.
